text: {"name":"sch_tx_arbitrate","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Processes pending MAC transmit-scheduling entries, unlocks members at cumulative 7-bit scheduling-value boundaries, retires entries, and signals the transmit system.","subsystem":"mac","var_renames":{"v0":"scheduler_state","v1":"critical_nesting","v2":"restore_irq_on_unlock","v3":"pending_schedule_list","v4":"schedule_entry","v5":"member_count","v6":"member_node","v7":"member_index","v8":"cumulative_schedule_value","v10":"current_member","v17":"selected_member"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":4,"meaning":"Schedule entry's first member pointer; member nodes also use this offset for their next pointer."},{"offset":8,"meaning":"Schedule entry member count."},{"offset":11,"meaning":"Member's 7-bit scheduling value, accumulated to determine unlock points."},{"offset":3074,"meaning":"Global pending schedule-entry count."},{"offset":3080,"meaning":"Global pending schedule-entry list."}]}
